prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1220; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy that applies to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may be available for this loss.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster files, repair estimates, and any electronic records or communications. Please take steps to ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response. Until we hear from you, our client's position is fully reserved, and nothing in this letter should be read as a waiver of any right or claim.
